summary: Nomura Holdings filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing a supplement of financial highlights for the six months ended September 30, 2026, incorporating the exhibit by reference into its existing Form F-3 shelf registration statements. Reported net revenue of 1,294.2 billion yen rose 24.6% year-over-year, with non-interest expenses up 26.0% to 934.7 billion yen, pre-tax income of 359.5 billion yen and net income attributable to shareholders of 249.3 billion yen. CET1 ratio was 12.6% versus 12.8% at March 31, 2026, and ROE 13.3%. No transaction, stake, price, premium or board recommendation is disclosed; the filing is an ordinary earnings disclosure with no deal mechanics or risk-arb angle to watch.
